summary: The filing is a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) disclosing a routine quarterly cash dividend declaration by the board of directors. The dividend is $0.37 per share payable on July 24, 2026 to holders of record on July 10, 2026. There is no special event or structural change—just an announcement of a regular dividend with no unusual terms, advisor, or strategic shift. This is a routine capital-allocation update, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or restructuring elements are present; the filing merely fulfills disclosure obligations for a standard dividend.
